title: Compute log conditioning probability without forming a tiny probability
statement: Exact fixed-dimensional polynomial-weight moments compute masses M_j and all coordinate-cut cumulative masses. Evaluate anchor log weights ell_j to eta accuracy by the charged factorial evaluator. Discard cells beyond a computed O_R(L) relative-anchor gap with total relative mass<=eta; rational exponentiation gives retained r_j=(1+-eta)W(m_j)/W(m_star). Compute exact positive rational Z_hat=sum r_j M_j. Output a=-sum lambda_i+ell_tilde_star+log_tilde Z_hat, evaluating rational logarithms by binary range reduction and convergent series. Global tails, local tails, discarded cells and relative polynomial/scaling error have certified conditional-mass bounds; allocated rational errors yield |a-log q|<=epsilon. Exponentially large negative log probabilities are stored as polynomial-length rationals. The algorithm never forms the exponentially tiny factor exp(-sum lambda_i), assumes a minimum q or receives a normalizer oracle.
